desc: Your Aspect of the Cosmos now stacks 1 additional time.

name: Unleashed Wisps
desc: Dealing damage with Scattered Stars has a % chance to launch a Wisp at your target, dealing its value Arcane damage to nearby enemies.

name: Vanguard's Shield
desc: Blocking an attack or landing an auto attack now grants a stack of Vanguard, stacking times.

name: Vengeance of Elune
desc: Causes Arcane damage to up to enemies within a few yards of the target, scaling with attack power and Intellect. Can only be used after parrying an attack. This attack cannot be avoided.

name: Vial of Moonwell Water
desc: Drink from your enchanted moonwell vial, instantly removing all crowd control effects and making you immune to them. Usable while stunned, feared, or polymorphed.

name: Vigil of the Moon
desc: Call one of Elune's watchers down to an area, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies.

name: Vigil of the Watchers
desc: Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by %. Does not stack with similar effects.

name: Virtue
desc: Increases your Attack Power by % of your Agility.

name: Warden Training
desc: Reduces the cooldown of Warden's Blade by %.

name: Warden's Blade
desc: Attack with celestial fervor, dealing % Weapon Damage and triggering a unique effect based on your active Aspect.

name: Warden's Fury
desc: Damage dealt by Umbral Blade now tethers enemies to you for sec. the tether is broken, they are gripped back towards you, taking its value Arcane Damage.

name: Warrior of Elune
desc: Increases your melee haste by % and movement speed by %. Movement speed granted by this talent stacks with Moonwalk.

name: Way of the Goddess
desc: Reduces the duration of harmful magic effects on you by %.

name: Wrath of Elune
desc: Reduces the cooldown of Sentinel Glaive by sec.

name: Wrath of Vashj
desc: Gives Moon Arrow a % chance to make your next Water Bolt instant.
